title: abtop — agent observability
blurb: A fleet-level monitor: auto-discovers every running Claude Code & Codex CLI session and puts the whole fleet on one terminal screen.
body:
abtop auto-discovers every running Claude Code and Codex CLI session and puts the fleet on one Ratatui screen: tokens, rate limits, context-window fill, orphan ports, subagent trees.

Where session-scoped tools like Claudoscope watch one run, abtop watches the operator running ten. No API keys, no auth — it reads local session files only. Rust, MIT-licensed, tmux-integrated.

The gap it fills was always fleet-level — observability across many parallel agents, not just inside one.

SOURCE · André Lindenberg (Agents, Graphs, Ontologies), LinkedIn. #agentObservability
